text:
jordana: Heads-up — I was cleaning up the private-deployments doc and found a paragraph under 'Audit logs & retention' that reads oddly for SOC2. It implies we purge all audit logs after TTL even if there's an open legal hold. link: https://redwood.example/docs/private/audit#retention

kevin: can you paste the snippet? I want to check the exact phrasing.

jordana: sure — current line: "Audit logs are retained for the configured TTL and are deleted thereafter." Feels like it omits legal hold/incident exceptions.

maggie: yeah that's risky phrasing. For SOC2 we need explicit: exceptions for legal hold, active investigations, or regulatory requests. Short patch suggestion: add a sentence clarifying exceptions and point to the legal-hold playbook.

samira: +1. Legal here — we require retention to respect legal holds. Suggest text: "Audit logs are retained per configured TTL unless subject to a legal hold, active investigation, or regulatory requirement; see Legal Hold Playbook (internal)."

kevin: can we also add a tiny SDK snippet showing how to mark data as under legal hold so docs readers know where to look? small example for retention API.

maggie: I mocked a compact snippet for the Node SDK: 
```js
// mark export as under legal hold
await redwood.auditExports.update(exportId, { legal_hold: true });
// release: { legal_hold: false }
```
Keep it short w/ link to full API.

samira: good. Add a note: legal holds override TTL and require manual release or court order. Also flag that audit exports may be encrypted; retention still applies but access must be preserved.

jordana: updated PR #4127 with the wording + snippet. pinging @kevin for review. PR description includes: changed one-sentence clarification, added node snippet, and cross-link to legal playbook.

kevin: reviewing now. small nits: prefer `legalHold: true` in snippet to match other SDK fields (camelCase). Also add a 1-line curl example for ops folks.

maggie: pushed fix to the snippet and added curl example: 
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit_exports/$EXPORT_ID" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"legalHold": true}'
```

docs-bot: CI check passed for docs build (docs/check-links). 1 broken internal link flagged earlier now fixed. :white_check_mark:

kevin: approved PR, left a tiny wording tweak for voice. Merging after CI. Thanks all — will also add a short blurb to the SOC2 checklist so reviewers don't miss this.

jordana: awesome, thanks. I'll follow up to add a short example in the retention FAQ page as well.

samira: thanks team. once merged I'll update legal playbook references if needed.

maggie: nice and tidy. closing thread. :rocket:
